title: Two-Story Wooden Farmhouse in Winter Snow, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot capturing a large two-story wooden clapboard house blanketed in deep winter snow. The home features a prominent front porch with classic columns and an upper-level railing, dark window trim, a side bay window, and gabled rooflines. Surrounding the residence are bare, leafless trees against an overexposed winter sky, embodying classic mid-20th-century rural or suburban American architecture.
